title: Meet the Former Trump White House Lawyer Who Says Our Democracy Could Be ‘Screwed’ in 2026
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
The amount of 'yes men' in President Donald Trump's second term can be
exhausting, especially when it comes to his team of suck-up
'[lawyers.](https://newrepublic.com/post/201936/jeanine-pirro-fails-fourth-
time-charge-dc-woman)'

Thankfully, Trump's former White House lawyer **Ty Cobb** - who
[represented](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/ty-cobb-trumps-lawyer-in-
russia-probe-retiring) the Trump White House during the Mueller investigation
back in 2017 - is not afraid to strike a different, more blunt tone.

**" We're screwed," **Cobb tells Mehdi, when asked about whether Trump's new
Attorney General [Todd Blanche](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/07/politics/live-
news/todd-blanche-confirmation-senate) will attempt to discredit midterm
election results.

Cobb's honest yet brutal assessment doesn't stop there in this 'Mehdi
Unfiltered' interview. **" Come 2028, does American democracy survive Donald
J. Trump?" **Mehdi asks him.

**" I'm not sure they survive it in 2026," **he says.

Mehdi**** also presses Cobb on his time representing the White House during
the Mueller investigation, asking him hard-hitting questions that **Zeteo** is
known for:

  * **" The Mueller report… lays out [10 episodes](https://www.politico.com/story/2019/04/18/mueller-report-transcript-trump-obstruction-justice-1281245) of potential obstruction of justice by Donald Trump. You don't deny any of that, do you?"**

  * **" When you were working for Donald Trump, did he ever ask you to obstruct justice?"**

  * **" Do you have no regrets going to work for Trump in term one?"**
